sentences.text: The submission is there was no need to call for the status-report whereas the learned Magistrate was expected to hear the Petitioner and to pass appropriate order whether to order an investigation under Section 156(3) of Code of Criminal Procedure,1973 ("Cr.P.C.") or not.

4. Mr.Kulkarni has invited my attention to the following documents:-
(a) The proceedings filed before the trial Court at Dadar.
(b) The complaint lodged to Wadala Police Station dated 30 th June 2023.
(c) The report submitted by the Wadala Police Station before the trial Magistrate on 14th September 2023.
It is taken on record and marked Annexure-X.
The report mentions two facts.
They are:-
(i) There is an offence registered at Matunga Police Station bearing C.R. No.368 of 2023 for the offences under Sections 409, 420, 120-B read with 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 ("IPC").
It was registered as per the directions given under Section 156(3) of Cr.P.C. by the Kurla Court on the complaint lodged by the Respondent No.1 - Hormuz Aderianwalla.
(ii) The report mentions that the inquiry with the Respondents on the complaint of present Petitioner is pending and after inquiry, they will submit a report to the learned Magistrate.
Learned APP seeks time to take instructions about what is the further progress on the basis of the said report.
In view of that, stand over to 29th August 2025.
To be listed under the caption "Fresh Admission".

[S. M. MODAK, J.]
